full_prompt_en: The image is a square black-and-white classic-film photograph of three formally dressed guests gathered around a dining table. At the left, an older white-haired man in a black dinner jacket and pale bow tie leans inward, speaking toward the two women. His face is close to the edge and turned right, creating an active diagonal into the scene. In the center, a dark-haired woman in a strapless black gown sits upright and looks sideways toward him, her expression composed and slightly questioning. A bright jeweled trim follows the top of the gown, and a pendant hangs at her chest. At the right, another woman with curled dark hair leans into the group, smiling softly in a pale draped evening dress and small earrings. Their shoulders nearly touch, filling the foreground in a compact triangular arrangement. On the table below, clear stemmed glasses, patterned plates, and two ornate tall candlestick-like vessels catch scattered highlights. Behind the three main figures, other guests are partly visible in shadow, with heavy curtains and framed wall decoration suggesting a crowded elegant room. The camera looks at seated height, with the closest table objects slightly larger and softer than the faces. Frontal light gives the pale skin smooth luminous tones, while black clothing, hair, and background recesses create connected dark masses. Small metallic and glass glints punctuate those shadows. Film grain remains fine and the edges have a gentle photographic softness. The whole composition feels social and theatrical, held together by exchanged looks, close cropping, and a controlled range of silver-gray highlights against deep black.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一张方形黑白经典电影摄影：三位盛装宾客聚在餐桌旁。左侧，一位白发年长男子穿黑礼服外套、系浅色领结，向内俯身，对两位女子说话。他的脸靠近画边并转向右，形成一条进入场景的活跃斜线。中央，一位深发女子穿无肩带黑礼服，坐得挺直，侧眼看向他，神情镇定且略带疑问。礼服上沿有闪亮珠饰，胸前垂着吊坠。右侧另一位卷曲深发女子靠进人群，穿浅色垂褶晚礼服、戴小耳环，柔和微笑。三人肩膀几乎相碰，在前景形成紧凑三角布局。其下桌面上，透明高脚杯、带花纹的盘子和两件华丽高烛台状器皿接住零散亮点。三位主角身后，其他宾客局部露在阴影里，厚窗帘和带框墙饰暗示一间拥挤而讲究的房间。相机处于坐着的人高度，最近的桌面物件比面孔略大且稍柔。正面光使浅色皮肤呈平滑明亮调子，黑衣、头发和背景暗凹处则连成暗块。细小金属与玻璃闪点刺破这些阴影。胶片颗粒细，边缘带温和的摄影柔度。整体构图社交气息浓厚且有戏剧感，由互相交换的目光、贴近裁幅和深黑前受控的银灰亮面连在一起。
style_prompt_en: Classic monochrome cinema photography packs several overlapping forms into a close triangular arrangement. Smooth pale silver-gray areas emerge from connected black fields, while small bright metallic and glasslike flecks scatter across a lower band. Soft frontal illumination models the focal shapes clearly; secondary layers recede into deep but detailed shadow. Fine film grain and gentle optical softness temper the crisp contrasts. Dark drapery-like verticals and framed tonal patches provide a dense backdrop without competing with the foreground. The rhythm is elegant and social, built from near-touching contours, shifted directional lines, and many small highlights inside a controlled grayscale range.
style_prompt_zh: 经典黑白电影摄影把几个交叠形体压进贴近的三角布局。平滑的浅银灰区域从相连黑场中浮出，细小金属般和玻璃般亮点散在下部色带。柔和正面光清楚塑造焦点形状；次要层次退入深而有细节的阴影。细胶片颗粒与温和的镜头柔度缓和清脆对比。暗色帘幕般竖线和带框的调子色片提供密实背景，又不与前景争夺注意。节奏优雅而有社交感，由几乎相碰的轮廓、转移的方向线，以及受控灰阶里的许多小亮点搭起。
theme_en: Three formally dressed guests gathered around a dining table
theme_zh: 三位盛装宾客聚在餐桌旁
name: George Cukor
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
